subject: Re: Syndigo security intake — vendor questionnaire returned, portal provisioning
body:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@syndigo.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Security intake — SOC 2 Type II + questionnaire + portal access

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — Syndigo’s security and procurement teams asked me to reach out with a few items so we can move toward a PO. Can you confirm the following?

- Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report we can review (or a planned date when it will be available)?
- Can you provide a signed bridge letter that attests to current controls while the report is finalized?
- We also have a short vendor security questionnaire attached — can you fill and return? (I attached syndigo_vendor_questionnaire_v1.xlsx)
- Finally, can you provision read-only access to your trust portal for our security reviewer (security@syndigo.com)?

If it helps, we can share a PO template / timeline once security gives the green light.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elena

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@syndigo.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security intake — SOC 2 Type II + questionnaire + portal access

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Next steps from our side (high level):

1) Monica (cc) will scope trust portal access and confirm what we can share (reports, evidence indexes, bridge letter).
2) I’ll route the questionnaire internally and return the filled copy by EOD Monday.
3) If SOC 2 Type II isn’t public yet we’ll provide a dated bridge letter; Monica will confirm ETA for the full report.
4) For procurement: if you can send a PO template to procurement@redwood.ai or procurement@syndigo.com (confirm which address we should expect), we’ll get pricing/contract out quickly.

Can we schedule a 20-minute sync with your security reviewer for Friday if needed? I put a tentative 11am ET slot on my calendar but happy to move.

Attaching a short onboarding checklist to speed the portal provisioning.

Thanks — Rishi

Attachments: redwood_svc_onboarding_checklist.pdf

-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@syndigo.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security intake — SOC 2 Type II + questionnaire + portal access

Hi Elena — Monica from Security here. Quick answers:

- SOC 2 status: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II testing for our inference platform in Q3 2026. The report is currently undergoing final legal review for distribution to customers under NDA; targeted public release (for customers with portal access) is 2026-12-07.

- Bridge letter: we have a standard bridge letter we provide for customers in the window before the report is published. I’m attaching the draft (redwood_bridge_letter_draft.docx). We can sign and return once you confirm recipient and approver.

- Trust portal: we can provision read-only reviewer accounts scoped to the Syndigo environment and evidence indexes. To create the user we need the reviewer’s full name and email, and a brief justification — a 1-line approval from your security lead is sufficient.

- Vendor questionnaire: we’ll complete the Excel and return with notes on required evidence.

Ben — can you confirm whether we should include the customer success manager on the portal invite or keep this only to the security reviewer?

Best,
Monica Patel
Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_draft.docx

-----
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@syndigo.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@syndigo.com, security@syndigo.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:31:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security intake — SOC 2 Type II + questionnaire + portal access

Thanks Monica — that timeline looks good.

Our reviewer is: Diego Ramirez <security@syndigo.com> (read-only). Justification: standard security intake for platform procurement. Please provision the reviewer account with access to the evidence index and SOC 2 artifact folder.

I’ve filled the questionnaire and attached it as syndigo_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx. We’ll also route a PO template to procurement@redwood.ai by EOD Monday.

If you can send the bridge letter to legal@syndigo.com and copy me, we’ll get it signed and returned.

Elena

Attachments: syndigo_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx

-----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@syndigo.com>, Diego Ramirez <security@syndigo.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security intake — SOC 2 Type II + questionnaire + portal access

Elena / Diego — quick update:

- Portal invite: provisioning complete. Diego should receive a one-time access link (trust_portal_invite.txt) — that link allows a read-only reviewer session scoped to Syndigo evidence. Please confirm you can access and view the SOC 2 index.
- Questionnaire: thank you — we’ve received syndigo_vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx and I’ve routed it to our security team for responses; expect the filled responses + evidence references by COB Wednesday (2026-12-02).
- Bridge letter: Monica attached the draft; I’m sending the signed bridge letter to legal@syndigo.com via DocuSign (https://docusign.example/ND-000432).

Ben — please add the CSM to the portal invite as discussed if we think it helps with onboarding.

Next steps for you: confirm portal access, confirm the PO routing address (procurement@redwood.ai or procurement@syndigo.com), and confirm whether you want the CSM included.

Thanks — Rishi

Attachments: redwood_trustportal_invite.txt
